title: Pyramidal Recurrent Unit for Language Modeling
answer_short: PTB dataset, WT-2 dataset, 19M parameters, hidden layer sizes 1000, 1200, 1400, standard dropout, advanced dropout, grouped linear transformation, pyramidal transformation
answer_rationale: The data used includes the PTB and WT-2 datasets (Text 3), with model parameters fixed at 19M (Text 3). Hidden layer sizes were set to 1000, 1200, and 1400 for INLINEFORM1 values of 1, 2, and 4 respectively (Text 3). Regularization methods included standard dropout and advanced dropout (Text 2). Transformations used were grouped linear and pyramidal (Text 1, Text 7).
